guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve the distinction between candidate, immutable tag, Draft/stable Provider Release, and public distribution evidence.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Contract and release workflow keep candidate, tag, Draft Release, public assets, and projection as separate evidence boundaries.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use only the controlled release workflow for external Provider mutation.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Contract names .github/workflows/release.yml as the only Provider mutation path.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not retry a failing release path until the exact failing gate is diagnosed and recorded.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Contract requires fail-closed gate diagnosis and records each external handoff/receipt in the append-only event log.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Never claim v0.5.70 publication or public installation success before Provider-bound evidence verifies it.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The acceptance criteria require Provider receipt, public assets, tagged Quick Install, and post-publication distribution evidence.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep the final Outcome as a standalone human-facing report in the conversation, not a raw evidence-file dump.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Contract requires a standalone traffic-light Outcome after all evidence and lifecycle gates complete.

risk.detail: v0.5.70 publication creates an immutable public tag and assets; source identity, supply-chain evidence, and post-publication projection must remain bound.

observedIssues.issue: The first formal Provider dispatch was rejected with HTTP 403 because the active gh account was xinglun and lacked repository push/admin permission.
observedIssues.resolution: Switched the active github.com account to RayIori, verified gh api user=RayIori and repository permissions admin=true/push=true, then reran the exact formal dispatch successfully. No Provider mutation occurred during the rejected attempt.

observedIssues.issue: The first post-publication projection sync stopped fail-closed because the newly reserved v0.5.70 tag lacked an unavailableTags explanation.
observedIssues.resolution: Reran the canonical synchronizer with the explicit stable_release_unverified unavailable entry and the public v0.5.70 Release URL as evidence; synchronization then passed.

observedIssues.issue: A generic release preflight run after publication evaluated the new v0.5.71 candidate against the old v0.5.70 freeze and reported expected post-publication diagnostic mismatches.
observedIssues.resolution: Used the post-publication distribution, release-state consistency, and source-bound evidence gates for the already-published v0.5.70; no v0.5.71 freeze was created and no historical release metadata was changed.

residualRisks.detail: v0.5.71 is intentionally unpublished and remains a candidate until a future exact-source release WI authorizes and verifies its publication.
